Q: Difference between MongoDB and MongoDB altas A:

Revised:

While the Q&A cited by @ray gives a very good and detailed answer, the following may be a summarised one more focussed towards new entrants.

While MongoDB is a database technology from MongoDB Inc, MangosDB Atlas is service or a Database service by the same company.

MongoDB as a technology is used in two modes. Most fundamentally as a single instance of a MongoDB database process, also as a system of multiple instances of MongoDB database processes. The second form of this technology is called MongoDB replica set.

Both of the above mentioned modes, are mainly used for developmental purpose. The main difference between the two is, some MongoDB database features like Transactions and Change Streams are available only in Replica set.

As we know, for productive purpose, it requires high availability. Therefore there is a need of multiple physical nodes, geographically distributed, hosting multiple Replica sets are required. This kind of set up results a cluster of multiple mongoDB database processes. MongoDB Atlas is such cluster service provided by MongoDB Inc, as stated in the beginning.
